## PUDO Phase Summary

### Plan

- [ ] Scope is clear
- [ ] Success criteria are measurable
- [ ] Out-of-scope items are listed

### Understand

- [ ] Relevant files were inspected
- [ ] Existing patterns were followed
- [ ] APIs, schemas, commands, or dependencies were verified

### Develop

- [ ] Diff is focused
- [ ] Tests were added or updated when needed
- [ ] Edge cases were handled or explicitly deferred

### Optimize

- [ ] Self-review is done
- [ ] Docs were updated if needed
- [ ] Remaining risks are listed

### AI Safety

- [ ] No invented APIs, paths, env vars, or config keys
- [ ] No unrelated rewrites
- [ ] No hidden behavior or contract changes
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or local-only paths added
